implication: Regulation 31(4) disclosure marks a triggering event in the acquirer's shareholding (likely crossing the 5% or 25% threshold); review whether public shareholding falls below 25% and what open offer, creeping acquisition, or exemption mechanics apply.

framework.note: Mandatory disclosure when a person acquires 5% or more of the voting capital or on each increase of 2% thereafter; disclosure must be filed within 2 trading days.
Open offer triggered if acquisition results in holding >25% or if acquirer/group already holds >25% and acquires >2% in a calendar year.
Exemption available for acquisitions up to 5% per financial year if holding is already >25%; applies subject to disclosure and valuation conditions.
Companies must maintain a register of members and shall disclose members holding >5% of voting capital.
